title: Agents capabilities
description: What the Agents folder can do when called, as opposed to the skills an agent reads.

entities.name: Validation of .dev folders
entities.description: Checks a repository's .dev files and actor files against the schemas kept here, and checks those schemas against their own examples first.
entities.responsibility: Tells whoever runs it whether every view, knowledge file and actor file in a repository is well-formed, and which file to fix if not; it does not tell whether they are true.
access: Nothing checks who runs it: anyone with a checkout and Python with jsonschema installed.
It only reads the repository; it changes no file.

relatedViews.relationship: The two validators through which it is reached.
The use case that uses it.
